m_26_14.description: Normalize passively-observed network device signals (NetFlow/IPFIX, DHCP, DNS, ARP, Packetbeat, Suricata) into the M-26-14 asset model. MAC OUI -> vendor/device_class via the m_26_14-oui-vendor enrich policy; OT-protocol and DHCP vendor-class refinement; populates asset.* + host.* (Entity Store host engine) + m_26_14.* coverage flags. Source docs must set m_26_14.observed_via (netflow|dhcp|dns|arp|packetbeat|suricata).

description: Normalize passively-observed OT/IoT network device signals into the M-26-14 asset model (OUI vendor enrich, OT-protocol tagging, asset/host entity population).

script.description: Derive lowercase 24-bit OUI prefix from source.mac; init device object.

enrich.description: MAC OUI -> vendor + device_class + ot flag

script.description: Apply vendor/class/ot; DHCP vendor-class + OT-protocol refinement; populate asset.* + host.* + related.*; set m_26_14 coverage flags.
